item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Nice floors! C. 1820 in Massachusetts. $299,900
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! The floors could really be amazing! The house was built in 1820. It is located on .5 acre in Sheffield, Massachusetts. The house features a covered side porch, attached two car garage, wood floors, large fireplace, chair rails and a spacious kitchen. This is a big house! Six bedrooms, six bathrooms and 3,683 square feet. $299,900 Contact Nicholas DeCaro with Property Works New England: 860-281-5688 From the Zillow listing: Come this charming 1820 col

item.title: 7 beds/5 baths! Almost three acres in Michigan. $299,900
item.description: This house has some pretty details! It’s a big house with 7 beds/5 baths! This former bed and breakfast was built in 1883. It is located on 2.83 acres in Newberry, Michigan. The house features a covered front porch, pressed tin ceiling, coffered ceiling, wood floors, wainscoting, ceiling medallions and crown moulding. There is a large back deck, a fenced paddock and outbuildings. Seven bedrooms, five bathrooms and 3,575 square feet. $299,900 Contact Kristine McCraren with Grower Real Estate: 906

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Nice porch! Over two acres in North Carolina. $199,900
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! Nice porch. The house was built in 1908. It is located on 2.28 acres in Bailey, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, wide baseboards, crown moulding and wood ceilings. There is a screened in back porch, patio and a detached storage building. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,760 square feet. $199,900 Contact Theresa Blackmon with Parrish Realty Company: 919-621-9063 From the Zillow listing: GREAT INVESTMENT AND REDU

item.title: Love the long driveway! On 37 acres in Virginia. $519,500
item.description: I love a house with a long driveway! This one does not disappoint! Pretty old growth trees too. The house was built in 1881. It is located on 37.92 acres in Buchanan, Virginia. The house features an enclosed front porch, baseboards, crown moulding, picture rails, updated kitchen, wainscoting, built-in bookshelves, french doors, some wood floors and updated bathrooms. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,120 square feet. $519,500 Contact Brian R.

item.title: Porch goals! Has a pool! Circa 1900 in Mississippi. $279,900
item.description: Porch goals! Nice pool! The house was built in 1900. It is located in Columbus, Mississippi. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, crown moulding, built-ins, claw foot tub, wainscoting, jib windows, original mantels, updated kitchen, bead board and a crystal chandelier. There is a fenced in backyard with an in-ground pool, detached garage and a detached storage shed. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,395 square feet. $279,900 Contact Kelly Frady with Coldwell Banke

item.title: Beautiful staircase! Great porch with fireplace! Over 18 acres in Missouri. $499,000
item.description: That is a beautiful staircase! I love the screened in porch with the fireplace! The house was built in 1840. It is located on 18.58 acres in Marshall, Missouri. The house features double front porches, covered side porch, screened in porch with a fireplace, grand staircase, wood floors, wide baseboards, wainscoting, crown moulding and updated plumbing/electrical. The home was originally built for John Locke Hardeman. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 4,340 square feet. $499,000 Contact Shelly O

item.title: Pretty staircase! Circa 1897 in Nebraska. $130,000
item.description: This house has a pretty staircase! Nice, unpainted woodwork. The house was built in 1897. It is located on .3 acre in Superior, Nebraska. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, pretty staircase, back staircase, updated kitchen, pocket doors, crown moulding, baseboards, french doors, large laundry room, bead board wainscoting and bay windows. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,259 square feet. $130,000 Contact Sidney Rokusek with Keller

item.title: I want the sink! Pretty details! Over one acre in New Hampshire. $389,000
item.description: I want that kitchen sink! This house has some nice details! The house was built in 1897. It is located on 1.29 acres in Claremont, New Hampshire. The house features a covered side porch, staircase with built-in seating, fireplace with rare Donatello Putti casting, wood floors, built-in bookshelves, chair rails, picture rails, exposed beams and a beautiful soapstone sink. The yard has mature trees and there is a large garage. There are views of Arrowhead Mountain and the home overlooks Monadnock

item.title: Lakefront in New Jersey! Nice interior. Circa 1935. $479,900
item.description: Unique lakefront house in New Jersey. The house was built in 1935. It is located in West Milford, New Jersey. The house features a private setting, stone exterior, a covered front porch, wood floors, some exposed log walls, vaulted ceiling, loft area and a stone fireplace. There is a pretty sunroom and a large back deck with views of the lake. The home is situated on Gordon Lake. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,395 square feet. $479,900 Contact Mai Chung with Keller Williams Elite Realtors:

item.title: Pretty interior! Circa 1945 in New York. $229,000
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! A lot of natural light. The house was built in 1945. It is located in Gloversville, New York. The house features wood floors, pretty fireplace, built-in bookshelves, baseboards, wainscoting, arched entryways, crown moulding and an updated kitchen. There is a fenced in backyard and a detached garage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,450 square feet. $229,000 Contact Melissa W. Woodcock with Staged Nest Real Estate: 518-369-8441 From the Zillow listing: Welcome
